title: MechAgents: Multi-agent modeling for solving mechanics problems with large language models

defines.name: MechAgents
defines.definition: A physics-inspired multi-agent LLM platform that autonomously collaborates to formulate, code, execute, critique, and solve mechanics problems.

problem: Mechanics simulations require deep expertise in theory, coding, debugging, and analysis, while existing ML approaches lack flexibility for incorporating physical insights and new knowledge.
